svg.desc: Firefighting & Plumbing Works at Tanta University LOCATION Tanta, Egypt CLIENT CIB STATUS EST. VALUE In Progress ~30 million EGP DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Firefighting & plumbing works of surgical building at Tanta University. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision and project management. The multidisciplinary services covered urban planning & design, architectural design, structural / civil engineering, mechanical engineering and electrical engineering.
